snippet.title: Iconoclast Release Trailer | Glenwood Highschool
snippet.description:
Get the game here: https://sandsowo.itch.io/iconoclast

The Iconoclast is a powerful evil entity that no hunter has been able to kill.
It compromises buildings in the form of natural disasters,  then feeds on the victims and creates a "nest" in the place for 88 days.

As a Hunter of supernatural beings, you come across an article about
Glenwood Highschool from 2 months ago and learn about its destruction.

Explore and survive on the first map of the game, Glenwood Highschool.
Gather keys to unlock rooms and lockers. Find items to use for your aid.
Use crucifixes and draw holy symbols to repel evil.
Find the Iconoclast and free the Highschool from its grip.
